name: skydiscover
description: SkyDiscover plugins for Codex. SkySynth builds a system specialized for your workload, hardware, and requirements, and checks it with tests or proofs.

plugins.name: skysynth
plugins.description: /skysynth: coding agents build a system specialized for your workload, checked by tests or machine-checked proofs. Includes the /skysynth skill and the hook that runs the tests before anything is delivered. Codex plugins cannot ship the agent roles yet: add them with skydiscover init --agent codex. Also install the skydiscover Python package: uv pip install git+https://github.com/skydiscover-ai/skydiscover (or run from a source checkout).
